title: Hodge conjecture

original_target.title: Hodge conjecture
original_target.statement: For every smooth complex projective variety, every rational Hodge class of type (p,p) is a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles.
proof_obligations: Handle every smooth complex projective variety and every codimension.
Construct algebraic cycle representatives with exact hypotheses.
A verified finite matrix or a special family does not establish the general conjecture.
original_target.research_focus: Reviewed result in docs/HODGE-DEGREE-OBSTRUCTION.md: dense elliptic Hecke orbits have unbounded transport-graph degrees. A finite list of Hilbert-polynomial tuples for cycle representatives on Zariski-dense fibers suffices for a proper spreading argument. Seek a precise sufficient bound on representative geometry, or test whether a uniform bound on total component degree with a fixed polarization suffices by relative Chow schemes. Keep the general class and codimension fixed.
